rule.name: RequestThreadLocalNotCleared
rule.message: This servlet filter stores a value in a ThreadLocal (set) or in the logging context (MDC.put, ThreadContext.put) while it handles a request, and the class never removes it. Server threads are pooled and reused, so the value is still there when the thread serves the next request: the next user reads the previous tenant, locale or security context, and the log lines of unrelated requests carry the old values. Remove the value in a finally block that wraps chain.doFilter: threadLocal.remove(), MDC.remove(key), a set or put that restores the saved previous value, or use try (var ignored = MDC.putCloseable(key, value)). An exception fits a value that is meant to live as long as the thread and is cleared by another class.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $helper := '^(remove|clear|reset|unset|cleanup|cleanUp|release|restore|close|detach|end|pop)\w*$', $kv := function($cls, $k) { let $init := $cls/FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] /VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $k/self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name] /StringLiteral return if ($k/self::StringLiteral) then string($k/@Image) else if (exists($init)) then string($init[1]/@Image) else '' }, $mdcRemoved := function($cls, $key) { let $v := $kv($cls, $key) return exists($cls//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#remove(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#remove(_)') or ((pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#put(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#put(_,_)')) and exists(ancestor::FinallyClause))] [$v = '' or $kv($cls, ArgumentList/*[1]) = '' or $kv($cls, ArgumentList/*[1]) = $v]) }, $mdcCleared := function($cls) { exists($cls//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#clear()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#putCloseable(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#setContextMap(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#removeAll(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#clearAll()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#clearMap()')]) }, $tlCleared := function($cls, $recv) { let $n := string($recv/@Name), $q := string($recv/TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName) return exists($cls//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'remove'][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][string(*[1]/@Name) = $n]) or exists($cls//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'set'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1][exists(ancestor::FinallyClause)] [string(*[1]/@Name) = $n]) or exists($cls//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'set'][ArgumentList/NullLiteral][string(*[1]/@Name) = $n]) or ($q != '' and exists($cls//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $helper)] [*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName = $q]])) } return for $m in //ClassDeclaration[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.servlet.Filter') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.servlet.Filter') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter')] /ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Name = ('doFilter', 'doFilterInternal')][FormalParameters/@Size = 3] return (let $cls := $m/parent::ClassBody return $m//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'set'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1][empty(ArgumentList/NullLiteral)] [empty(ancestor::FinallyClause)] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.ThreadLocal')]] [not($tlCleared($cls, *[1]))]) | (let $cls := $m/parent::ClassBody return $m//MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.slf4j.MDC#put(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext#put(_,_)')] [empty(ancestor::FinallyClause)] [not($mdcCleared($cls)) and not($mdcRemoved($cls, ArgumentList/*[1]))])
